category_title: Students who engage in gossiping and bystander behavior
minimal_context: The student is working on a group project with friends in the classroom.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please start working on your group project with Jill.

STUDENT: Okay. Hey Jill, did you hear what the other group was doing? I heard they...

TUTOR: What do you think you should be doing right now?

STUDENT: Right, sorry. Me and Jill have been working together on that and like when I start saying something then we will remind each other to not say that.

TUTOR: Keep trying to focus on the assignment.

STUDENT: I have been trying to do a lot better on that gossiping and it’s really hard, but it’s just a work in progress I guess. It's just really hard to stop when everyone else is talking.

options.A: Implements systematic instruction and provides frequent, effective feedback to the student during the group project.
options.B: Walks around the classroom and stands directly behind the student during the group project activity.
options.C: Jokes around frequently and laughs at themselves while the student works on the group project.
options.D: Prefaces the group project by stating that if there is a problem, they will discuss the challenge course.
